What is Ceramill Motion 3?

The Ceramill Motion 3 is a groundbreaking 5-axis milling system that seamlessly integrates advanced Computer-Aided Design (CAD) and Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM) technology. This innovation allows us to produce custom dental crowns, bridges, and even same-day* dental implants with exceptional precision. By eliminating the need for outsourcing it, we reduce treatment times while maintaining strict quality control, ensuring that each restoration fits and functions perfectly.
